rubric_notes: Correct placement of core histones (a.22.1.1), archaeal (a.22.1.2), TAF/NF-Y/NC2/Sos (a.22.1.3), and bacterial (a.22.1.4) families in superfamily a.22.1 with correct SUNIDs in SCOPe 2.08; superfamily supports probable distant homology but does not justify transferring chromatin, DNA-wrapping, transcriptional, or interaction functions; fold and class explicitly treated as weaker; linker histones (a.4.5.13), H-NS (a.155.1), and histone-modifying enzymes correctly excluded; sensible template-selection guidance. Identifiers supported by bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-22.

Correct families a.204.1.2 / a.204.1.4 with correct SUNIDs, shared superfamily a.204.1 (101386), remote homology vs. mere fold similarity, and family divergence. Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily and fold, supported by bundle including homology endpoint. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; 2026-10-22. Correct families, superfamily, fold, class with matching SUNIDs; homology-implied-at-superfamily reading supported by bundle. Explicitly frames remote common ancestry followed by active-site divergence versus convergent all-alpha fold, and notes class/fold are weaker than superfamily. Keeps chemistries family-specific, warns the RNR-like family name does not mean every member reduces ribonucleotides; refuses transfer of metal identity, ligand geometry, residues, substrate, assembly, mechanism; lists alignment, ligand conservation, spectroscopic metal identification, oligomeric evidence, assays. Periodic-update label not in this bundle but accurate. Complete.

Family 'lacking metal-binding site' comment not cited but not required.

Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily 52172, fold c.23, class c, release 2.08. Remote common ancestry at superfamily strength, not same-family equivalence. Explicitly rejects receiver-Asp phosphorelay/two-component signaling, ODC/PLP catalysis (wing is not the major catalytic domain), and KaiA/KaiC circadian signaling transfer. Correct families, superfamily, fold, class with correct SUNIDs. Superfamily = probable remote common origin vs fold; families = divergence. Rejects transfer of ADH activity, CoA binding, NAD(P) specificity, channel regulation; notes superfamily name does not prove NAD(P) binding; distinguishes domain core template from binding-site/whole-protein context; lists sequence-profile, structural, ligand-bound, biochemical, electrophysiological evidence. Classifications and SUNIDs correct and bundle-supported: c.2 51734, c.3 51904, c.25 52342, d.58.20 55035, different classes. Convergence framed as supported by cross-fold recurrence, divergence by superfamily membership; hierarchy strength (family > superfamily > fold > class) stated correctly, and neither fold nor cofactor licenses homology. Strong chemical-constraint argument and whole-domain evidence integration (profile/structural alignment, topology, boundaries, residue networks, phylogeny/genomic context) plus biochemical requirement for function transfer and template caveats. The 'latest reported periodic update: 2.08-2026-08-16' claim is not supported by any endpoint in this answer's bundle (no /releases/current cited), so that noncentral release detail is unsupported. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Classification history is correct (2.04 b.23.2.1 CUB-like versus b.18.1.3; 2.08 shared superfamily b.18.1 with families b.18.1.36 and b.18.1.3, correct SUNIDs), and the homology-versus-family distinction, functional caveats, and refusal to transfer collagen binding, receptor specificity, toxicity, or catalysis are all handled well. Decisive problem: the central quantitative claim, a purported direct TM-align of API coordinates for 1nqdA against 1dlc A:500-644 giving 97 aligned residues, 3.57 A RMSD, 6.2% identity, and TM-scores 0.571/0.471 normalized to 111- and 145-residue domains, is not present in or derivable from the evidence bundle, which contains no coordinate responses or alignment results. Invented numeric evidence presented as API-derived triggers the fabrication ceiling on factual support; the representative-based FATCAT figures it also reports are accurate and correctly attributed to 1nqjA.

Thorough and correct: new superfamily default; new family = probable common ancestry with closer subgroup; singleton superfamily makes no pairwise homology claim; new fold = distinct arrangement/topology, not proof of independent origin and not warranted by unproven homology; names sequence/profile, structural alignment, motif, mechanistic, and genomic-context evidence that can strengthen or overturn the hypothesis. Hierarchy class>fold>superfamily>family>protein>species>domain is correct. Attributes the 2.08 stable release and the 2.08-2026-08-16 periodic update label to the API with an empty evidence bundle, so those citations are unsupported (noncentral). Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct release 2.08 hierarchy with SUNIDs (fold 56111, superfamily 56112, families 56171/d.144.1.4, 64411/d.144.1.6, 88854/d.144.1.7), all in bundle; correctly notes the homology endpoint implies homology at superfamily but not at fold level. Infers homologous catalytic core and shared ATP-dependent phosphoryl-transfer framework rather than convergent fold similarity. Explicitly declines to transfer substrate, residue/lipid position, inhibitor profile, kinetics, activation mechanism, partners, localization or regulatory circuit across families. Evidence requirements: orthology/phylogeny within family, conserved catalytic/specificity residues and boundaries, substrate/nucleotide/metal complexes in relevant conformations, binding and kinetic assays, specificity profiling, mutagenesis, full-length regulatory context, partners, oligomeric state, membrane recruitment, cellular/genetic data. Template-selection caveat appropriate. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.
